get.description: Server-sent events. Each message has `id` (the stream position; send it back as `Last-Event-ID` to resume), `event` and JSON `data`. Without `Last-Event-ID` the stream starts with new items. Authorization is re-checked periodically; the stream ends with an `error` event when access is lost and closes after `events.sse_max_seconds` (reconnect to continue). Only the latest state of a job is guaranteed; intermediate states may be skipped.
